title: Foundry agent definition
description: Hosted or prompt agent. Items in an agents array may be inline (hosted or prompt) or a $ref to an external file.

env.description: Environment variables for the agent runtime. Values may use ${VAR} (azd env) or ${{...}} (Foundry server-side resolution).

toolboxes.description: Names of toolboxes the agent uses (declared in toolboxes[]).

tools.description: Tools attached directly to this agent (alternative or in addition to toolboxes[]).

skill.description: Name of a skill (declared in skills[]) this agent is backed by.

project.description: Relative path to the agent source directory. Required when docker: or runtime: is set.

image.description: Pre-built container image. Mutually exclusive with project + docker / runtime.

docker.description: Container build options. Mutually exclusive with runtime:.

path.description: Path to Dockerfile relative to project.

remoteBuild.description: If true, build in Azure Container Registry instead of locally.

runtime.description: Code-deploy runtime stack. Mutually exclusive with docker:.

startupCommand.description: Command to start the agent process (e.g., 'python main.py').

sessionConfiguration.description: Optional hosted-agent session runtime settings. When omitted, the service applies its defaults (idle timeout 900 seconds).

idleTimeoutSeconds.description: Idle duration in seconds before a session's sandbox is suspended. Range 300–3600 (inclusive). Defaults to 900 when omitted.

model.description: Name of the model deployment the agent runs on (for example "gpt-4.1-mini"). Must match a deployment declared on the sibling azure.ai.project service.

instructions.description: The system/developer message inserted into the model's context. Declared inline.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Lower values make output more deterministic. Omit to use the model default; prefer setting either temperature or top_p, not both.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling cutoff. Omit to use the model default; prefer setting either temperature or top_p, not both.

text.description: Configuration for the model's text response, most commonly the structured output format (for example text.format.type: json_schema).

reasoning.description: Configuration for reasoning-model behavior (for example reasoning.effort). Only meaningful on models that support reasoning.

memory.description: Durable recall carried across invocations, backed by a Foundry memory store. The store is created if it does not exist, and a memory_search_preview tool bound to it is added to the agent's tools automatically.

store.description: Name of the memory store. Created if it does not already exist, reused if it does.

description.description: Description recorded on the memory store when it is created.

chat_model.description: Model deployment name the store uses to summarize conversations into memories.

embedding_model.description: Model deployment name the store uses to embed memories for retrieval.

scope.description: Namespace that isolates memories, typically per user. Defaults to "{{$userId}}", which resolves the caller's object ID at runtime so one user's memories never surface in another's conversation.

update_delay.description: Seconds of conversation inactivity to wait before extracting memories. Omit to use the service default (300). Low values extract on nearly every turn and are intended for demos.

max_memories.description: Maximum number of memories a single search returns. Omit to use the service default.

options.description: Toggles for which memory kinds the store extracts. Omitted toggles keep the service default.
